hints.title: Indentation Level Determines Directory Depth
hints.text: The count of leading tab characters in each line directly dictates the hierarchical nesting depth of the file or directory.

hints.title: Prefix Path Length Tracking by Level
hints.text: Maintain the cumulative character path length for each indentation level in a collection, replacing deeper entries when moving back up.

hints.title: Single Pass Tab Counting and File Detection
hints.text: Split input by newline. For each line, count leading tabs as depth, slice the name, compute cumulative length as path[depth - 1] + len + 1. If name contains a period, update max absolute length.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal linear O(N) time and O(D) auxiliary space bounded by maximum tree depth.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-traversing full path prefixes for every file produces quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dictionary / map maps nesting depth to prefix length in O(1) time per node.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should identify files by checking for a dot extension and account for slash separator lengths.
